description: Fast binary go/no-go economic dispatch decision comparing a single terrestrial electricity price or live hub (ERCOT, PJM, EPEX) against the orbital breakeven threshold ($/MWh). Returns exact dispatch_signal (ORBIT_PRIMARY, HYBRID_SPLIT, TERRESTRIAL_PRIMARY), dispatch_directive, breakeven threshold, and $/MTok spread. Use ONLY for binary grid-vs-orbit switching; use solve_optimal_workload_allocation for 3-shell percentage splits.

grid_hub.description: Live wholesale electricity hub to evaluate when grid_price_usd_mwh is omitted.

grid_price_usd_mwh.description: Explicit local spot electricity price in USD/MWh (supports negative wind/solar spot prices). If omitted, uses grid_hub.

hw.description: Hardware stack profile determining $/MTok and breakeven $/MWh.

power_mw.description: Cluster scale in MW used to size launch/bus overhead and breakeven threshold.

storm_mode.description: Space-weather mode for pre-emptive storm failover triggers.

name: compute_arbitrage_dispatch
